question: Should durable multi-hop lineage be owned by SessionEntry/session APIs, by TaskFlow task records, or by an explicit shared bridge between them?
rationale: Current main has two partial ownership models—direct session parent/depth metadata and TaskFlow flow/task identity—and repository behavior does not establish which should become the permanent root and trace contract.

options.title: Bridge Sessions And TaskFlow
options.body: Define one shared lineage identity and project it through both session and task APIs without creating independent roots or traces.

options.title: Session-Owned Lineage
options.body: Persist root and trace identifiers directly on spawned sessions and treat TaskFlow as an optional higher-level consumer.

options.title: TaskFlow-Owned Lineage
options.body: Keep sessions limited to direct parent/depth metadata and direct durable DAG reconstruction to TaskFlow task APIs.

recommendation.title: Bridge Sessions And TaskFlow
recommendation.body: Define one shared lineage identity and project it through both session and task APIs without creating independent roots or traces.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest combined issue-review and central session-boundary history in the available evidence.
